cc:Work.dc:title: RTX PRO 6000 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · one pod
cc:Work.dc:description: On one RTX PRO 6000 the AX tree leads stock vLLM DFlash2 on every workload at one client and AX GDN replay on every workload at eight.

g.text: 128 greedy output tokens per request · 8 prompts at C1, 24 at C8 per workload · two servers per lane · cute-dsl FP4 GEMMs

g.text: AX lanes admit one DFlash prefill at a time (launch default at 8 slots). First sweep of every server dropped (both engines).
